The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Identifies the domain layer as Conditional and not needed for simple logic
- Declines to add it by default and states the threshold for adding one
- Does not impose a heavier structure than the app needs
